orchestrator_notes.hidden_weakness: 99.3% coverage is driven by JHU annual-only national rows 1978-2012 and 2021-2022, plus two AI absence rows (1970-1977, 1986-1989) that are the only AI-only months (144). WHO weekly national ends 2026-05-24; AI cumulative ends 2026-06-07. Sub-annual and sub-national resolution is thin outside JHU 2013-2020 district weeklies and WHO 2023-2026 national weeklies.

orchestrator_notes.location_convention: Pre-2025 data: legacy 18 provinces spelled as JHU spells them (e.g. 'AFR::BDI::Bujumbura Mairie', 'AFR::BDI::Bujumbura Rural', 'AFR::BDI::Cibitoke'); health districts at level 3 as 'AFR::BDI::{Legacy Province}::{District} Sanitary District' (JHU style). Post-July-2025 sources reporting by the new 5 provinces (Buhumuza, Bujumbura, Burunga, Butanyerera, Gitega) may use AFR::BDI::{NewProvince} with a processing_notes flag '5-province system (post-2025 reform)'. Existing AI rows AFR::BDI::Isale / AFR::BDI::Bujumbura / AFR::BDI::Bujumbura_Rural are non-conforming; Agent 5/7 to normalize with revise_observation.py --location.
